SIR Controversy Jharkhand:
Jharkhand men SIR ki samay sima barhane ki mang par siyasi sangram chhir gaya hai... kangres ne nirvachan aayog ke samne 23 navanbar ki dedlain ko barhakar 23 disanbar karne ki mang rakhi hai...lekin kangres ki is mang par bijepi ne aisa palatvar kiya ki siyasi para charh gaya... bijepi ne saval uthaya ki aakhir kangres ko ek mahine ki mohlat kyon chahie... kya ghuspaithiyon ke nam votar list men jurvane ke lie samay manga ja raha hai?... vahin JMM ne bhi SIR ki mansha par saval khare karte hue ise rajnitik uddeshy se prerit bataya hai...ye riport dekhie...
